definitions.completion: Both fills eligible in corrected span/bell. Denominator all 100 selected; offered-game denominator separate. This is the existing grade OUTCOME metric, not safety certification.
definitions.one_sided: Exactly one corrected-span eligible fill. Unknown spans remain unknown, not unfilled.
definitions.captured: Unchanged rubric OUTCOME credit: incomplete valid pairs get zero; positive corrected under-par completed pair discount. No credit for unverified span. Grade hard failures remain F and are reported separately, not silently repaired or redefined.
definitions.offered: Positive corrected truth-table discount; unknown and nonpositive offers separated.
definitions.captured_per_game_offered: Captured cents on verified positive-offer games divided by count of those games.
definitions.worst: Among graded positive-offer games: worst current rubric letter first, then largest offered-minus-captured cents, then event ID. Unknown spans listed separately, not assigned performance failure.
definitions.fills: Replay credits are maker-reach simulations; no real orders and no known queue priority.
definitions.seal: Only the frozen selected100 ran; other704 unrun in this order. No historically-unseen assertion.
